new_libraries.name: KonnextraKNX
new_libraries.author: Florian Wiesner <wiesner.florian@gmx.at>
new_libraries.sentence: Talk to a KNX bus from an Arduino sketch — no ETS, no KNX-stack expertise required.
new_libraries.paragraph: Describes devices by what they are (KnxLight, KnxDimmLight, KnxRGB, KnxBlind, KnxTemperature, KnxHumidity, ...) instead of by datapoint tables. Handles KNX telegram framing, datapoint encoding, and bus timing through an ATTiny/STKNX co-processor link, exposed over a single header include.

new_libraries.name: Quectel_LCx6G_GNSS
new_libraries.author: Ugo Silato
new_libraries.sentence: Driver for Quectel LC26G, LC26G-T, LC76G and LC86G GNSS modules (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, BeiDou, QZSS): NMEA, PAIR/PQTM commands, UART or I2C. Tested on LC76G with Arduino Uno R3 and R4.
new_libraries.paragraph: Developed and tested on the LC76G (PA) with Arduino Uno R3 and Uno R4 Minima; the other modules share the same Quectel protocol (compatible, not tested). Integer-only NMEA decoder (RMC, GGA, GSV), PAIR and PQTM commands, automatic UART baud rate configuration, PQTM output messages (PVT, velocity, DOP, odometer, GPS time, ECEF), constellations, jamming detection, geofence, 1PPS, low power modes, AGNSS (EASY/EPOC), LOCUS logger, reception and output settings, safe power and reset pin control.

library.sentence: Arduino library for the I2C D-Pad module using the DevLab Device Protocol (DDP).

library.author: UNIT Electronics MX

library.sentence: Arduino library for the GT365xx light sensor (LDR) using DDP over I2C.
library.paragraph: DevLab GT365xx library for light acquisition through the DevLab Device Protocol (DDP) over I2C. Reads the 12-bit ADC value of the LDR voltage divider.

library.name: GFX Library for Arduino
library.author: Moon On Our Nation <moononournation@gmail.com>
library.sentence: Arduino_GFX is a GFX library for various color displays with various data bus interfaces
library.paragraph: Arduino_GFX is a Arduino graphics library. Currently support GC9A01 round display, GC9106, GC9107, HX8347C, HX8347D, HX8347G, HX8352C, HX8357A, HX8357B, HX8369A, ILI6122, ILI9225, ILI9331, ILI9341, ILI9342(M5Stack, ESP32-S3-BOX), ILI9481, ILI9486, ILI9488, ILI9806, JBT6K71, NT35310, NT35510, NT39125, NV3041A, OTM8009A, R61529, RM67162, SEPS525, SSD1283A, SSD1331, SSD1351, ST7735, ST7789, ST7796 and virtually all Raspberry Pi DPI (RGB) display. Tested RGB display: GC9503V, ILI6485, ST7262, ST7701. Currently support software SPI (8-bit and 9-bit), hardware SPI (8-bit, ESP32 also support 9-bit), 8-bit parallel interface(AVR, ESP32, RPi Pico, RTL8720, STM32), 16-bit parallel interface(ESP32 and RPi Pico) and RGB Panel interface(ESP32S3).

library.name: OtamaticClient
library.author: Timothy Franceschi
library.sentence: Automatic Remote OTA Client for ESP32.
library.paragraph: This library allows you to perform managed OTA updates on ESP32 devices through the Otamatic platform.
